id.description: The unique identifier for the integration

status.description: The current state of the integration (development, approved, archived)

created.description: The date the integration was created

updated.description: The date the integration was last updated

description.description: A description of what the integration does and how to use it

author.description: The name of the integration developer

contact.description: The URL or email address where users of the integration can reach out for support

uninstallation_url.description: The `delete` endpoint that initiates the uninstallation flow for the integration

oauth_callback_url.description: The `get` endpoint that will be invoked after OAuth authorization

tags.description: A list of tags that describe the type of integration

error_codes.description: An object containing error codes and their corresponding error message the integration may return to the OAuth failure page to be displayed

scopes.description: The list of OAuth token permissions the integration requests when installed

configuration_fields.description: A json-schema describing the settings fields that a user should be presented with when installing the integration

client_secret.description: The OAuth client secret for the integration

IntegrationIconUrl.description: The URL of the icon that should be displayed with your integration
IntegrationIconUrl.title: IntegrationIconUrl

IntegrationIdentifierField.description: JMESPath describing which of the fields in `configuration_fields` is the best human-friendly field to use to identify a specific installation (e.g., account name)
IntegrationIdentifierField.title: IntegrationIdentifierField

PlatformIntegrationConfigurationFields.description: A json-schema describing the settings fields that a user should be presented with when installing the integration
PlatformIntegrationConfigurationFields.title: PlatformIntegrationConfigurationFields

PlatformIntegrationErrorCodes.description: An object containing error codes and their corresponding error message the integration may return to the OAuth failure page to be displayed
PlatformIntegrationErrorCodes.title: PlatformIntegrationErrorCodes
